# Amazon Location Service

Persist tracker configuration and tags without device positions, geofence evaluation or location events.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `location` |
| Signing name | `geo` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2020-11-19` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 8 of 64 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-location-service) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- PositionFiltering is a configuration record only; no device positions/history, consumer associations, geofences, event delivery, encryption/IAM or execution readiness.
- PricingPlan/PricingPlanDataSource, KmsKeyId, EventBridgeEnabled and KmsKeyEnableGeospatialQueries are excluded, including false/null/empty inputs; no invented idempotency token.
- CF Description removal rejects (explicit empty clears); PositionFiltering removal restores TimeBased; compensation restores exact prior public timestamps with a fresh private revision guard.
- The exhaustive [records guide](../guides/location-records.md) describes selected members/defaults/limits/errors/scope/tags/CF and an executable lifecycle. Device positions, deprecated pricing decisions and consumer associations remain [future scope](../roadmap/services/location-runtime.md).

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateTracker` | `POST /tracking/v0/trackers` |
| `DeleteTracker` | `DELETE /tracking/v0/trackers/{TrackerName}` |
| `DescribeTracker` | `GET /tracking/v0/trackers/{TrackerName}` |
| `ListTagsForResource` | `GET /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `ListTrackers` | `POST /tracking/v0/list-trackers` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `UntagResource` | `DELETE /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `UpdateTracker` | `PATCH /tracking/v0/trackers/{TrackerName}` |
